channel.title: Creek Street
channel.description: Development and news for Creek Street, Ketchikan, Alaska.

item.title: Site update
item.description: Added The Star, the salmon ladder, the Tongass Historical Museum, the Chief Johnson totem pole and the New York Hotel to the map, and expanded the history timeline. Map numbers now run left to right.

item.title: Site update
item.description: Added the place directory and street map, history timeline, owner's checklist, visitor information, salmon timing and update dates on every project.

item.title: Site update
item.description: creekstreet.org launched as an independent community site.

item.title: Reaching owners and organizations
item.description: An effort to let property owners, businesses and Ketchikan organizations know how the review process works, so projects on the street are planned with it in mind from the start.

item.title: Public restrooms
item.description: The condition and availability of the public restrooms that serve Creek Street's visitors. The Borough's Public Works department is the next point of contact on their status.

item.title: Design review for exterior changes
item.description: Changes to building exteriors in the Creek Street district go through public design review again, after about a decade without meetings. Owners planning work on facades, signs, railings or decks should expect a review step.
